system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Second, I want to change my most recent reservation to the cheapest business-class round trip available, keeping the exact same dates. I’m flexible on routing, so nonstop isn’t necessary.

I don’t need bags or insurance.

And before we finalize anything, I want to know how much would end up being charged to my MasterCard after applying my certificates first, then gift cards, and then the card for whatever remains.

If it isn’t, then please check whether canceling the current reservation and booking a new cheapest business round trip on the same dates would reduce what gets charged to my MasterCard.

I’m mainly trying to minimize the MasterCard charge, so whichever option does that is the one I want.

This reservation is not changeable.

- Under the modification rules, basic economy flights cannot be modified.

- But to determine that, I first need to confirm whether your current reservation is eligible for cancellation under the cancellation rules.

Please tell me the reason for cancellation:
- change of plan
- airline cancelled flight
- other reasons

Once you tell me the reason, I can compare the cancel-and-rebook path against keeping the current reservation and identify which option minimizes the MasterCard charge.
Change of plan. Please go ahead and compare the cancel-and-rebook option and let me know which one gives me the lower charge to my MasterCard.

Here is the comparison.

Current reservation cancellation eligibility:
- Reservation: K1NW8N
- Reason: change of plan
- Booking created: 2024-05-14 16:03:16
- Current time: 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST
- All flight segments are still unflown

Result:

Comparison for minimizing your MasterCard charge:
- Modify current reservation to business: not allowed, because basic economy cannot be modified
- Cancel current reservation and book a new business reservation: not allowed, because this reservation is not eligible for cancellation for change of plan

So there is no eligible path I can complete that would reduce or replace the MasterCard charge for a business-class round trip on the same dates.

If you still want a new business-class booking on the same dates, I can help book it as a separate new reservation, but the current reservation would remain in place.

Understood. In that case, please book it as a separate new reservation on the same dates.
